title: uragoga fitzalanii

It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and as a remedy for snake bites. The health benefits of Uragoga fitzalanii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, including annonaceous acetogenins and other alkaloids.
